offers_products.reason: Sells customizable plush toys, stuffed animals, clothing and gift sets through Workshops and online.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from plush goods; the build-your-own experience is retail, plus minor commercial and franchise activity.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Shoppers, children and families buy plush toys in its Workshops and online.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to international franchisees and wholesale/retail partners for resale, a smaller part next to direct consumer sales.

recurring_revenue.reason: Mostly one-off toy and gift purchases, though some families return often; no subscriptions.

cyclical_demand.reason: Plush toys and gifts are discretionary; families can easily cut or postpone them in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Plush animals and gift sets are small, low-priced purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for plush toys and accessories, a product retail business rather than staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are households and families; no large enterprise or government customers.

asset_heavy.reason: Mostly leased mall and retail stores with outsourced manufacturing; limited heavy investment in plants or fleets.
